article.headline: Mount St. Mary's wins 78-68 against Canisius
article.description: — Arlandus Keyes' 22 points helped Mount St. Mary's defeat Canisius 78-68 on Saturday.

article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Arlandus Keyes' 22 points helped Mount St. Mary's defeat Canisius 78-68 on Saturday. Keyes also added six rebounds for the Mountaineers (7-12, 3-5 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Trey Deveaux scored 16 points while shooting 5 of 8 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line. Luke McEldon had 10 points and shot 5 of 7 from the field. Kahlil Singleton finished with 21 points for the Golden Griffins (8-11, 3-5). Bryan Ndjonga added 19 points, eight rebounds, five assists and two blocks for Canisius. Michael Evbagharu had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
